---
title: "Zero-inflation diagnostics"
---

# Summary
Diagnostic (not for the manuscript): checks whether CITE-seq ADT zero-inflation tracks (1) per-receptor mean count and (2) per-cell total ADT depth, as opposed to being purely biological absence.

```{python}
%config InlineBackend.figure_formats = ['svg']
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from bicytok.imports import importCITE

plt.rcParams["svg.fonttype"] = "none"

cell_categorization = "CellType2"
per_cell_sample_size = 5000
rand_state = 42

CITE_DF, _ = importCITE(cell_categorization)
counts = CITE_DF.to_numpy()

# Per-receptor stats, computed over all cells
rec_mean = counts.mean(axis=0)
rec_zero_frac = (counts == 0).mean(axis=0)

# Per-cell stats, computed over a sampled subset for a legible scatter
rng = np.random.default_rng(rand_state)
sample_idx = rng.choice(
    counts.shape[0], size=min(per_cell_sample_size, counts.shape[0]), replace=False
)
cell_counts = counts[sample_idx, :]
cell_total_count = cell_counts.sum(axis=1)
cell_zero_frac = (cell_counts == 0).mean(axis=1)
```

## Per-receptor zero-fraction vs. mean count
```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Per-receptor zero-fraction vs. per-receptor mean count, one point per receptor. Dashed line is the Poisson dropout null (exp(-mean))."
rho, pval = spearmanr(rec_mean, rec_zero_frac)

plt.figure(figsize=(5, 4))
plt.scatter(rec_mean, rec_zero_frac, alpha=0.6, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.3)

x_ref = np.logspace(
    np.log10(rec_mean[rec_mean > 0].min()), np.log10(rec_mean.max()), 100
)
plt.plot(
    x_ref, np.exp(-x_ref), color="red", linestyle="--", label="Poisson null: exp(-mean)"
)

plt.xscale("log")
plt.xlabel("Per-receptor mean count (all cells)")
plt.ylabel("Per-receptor zero-fraction")
plt.title(f"Spearman rho={rho:.2f}, p={pval:.1e}", fontsize=10)
plt.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle="--")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Per-cell zero-fraction vs. total ADT count
```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Per-cell zero-fraction across the receptor panel vs. per-cell total ADT count (summed across receptors), sampled cells."
rho_cell, pval_cell = spearmanr(cell_total_count, cell_zero_frac)

plt.figure(figsize=(5, 4))
plt.scatter(cell_total_count, cell_zero_frac, alpha=0.2, s=8, edgecolor="none")

plt.xscale("log")
plt.xlabel("Per-cell total ADT count (summed across receptors)")
plt.ylabel("Per-cell zero-fraction (across receptors)")
plt.title(f"Spearman rho={rho_cell:.2f}, p={pval_cell:.1e}", fontsize=10)
plt.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle="--")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
